entries.embedded_english: Miller…

<normal> Alright, what do we have here… 
*looking at clipboard*
Turner…
Great…
subtitle_missing
subtitle_missing
Now the other window, Miller…
Woohoo! Goodnight!
Outstanding, Miller.
Damn, would you look at that!  Bet they’ve been sneaking off the island for days!
Thousands of ‘em, I reckon.
Can't say I'm sorry to see 'em go.
Don't celebrate yet, Polonsky.  Every one of those Japanese you see escaping?  We'll be facing them all again on the next island...
Hell, we whooped ‘em once, we can whup ‘em again…
(On radio) Sullivan reporting, sir.  Happy to report, the Tokyo Express no longer comes to the end of the line at Guadalcanal...
Come on, Marines! Let's go up there and give them hell.
Stick a charge on that AA, Miller.
And another…
Okay - on three, I want you to move through these stables and take out the targets.
1… 2… 3.  Go, go, go!
Get amove on,  Miller. Under the net and through the obstacles - go, go !
Miller, take out that mortar crew!
Someone get Miller out of that mud!
I'm not running out into the open. We need some smoke to mask us!
Get in there!  Move it.
Miller. Where the hell is your rifle?
Sir Yes Sir!
Watch it.  Here he comes…
Okay.  To aim better, you can look down the rifle's sight, but otherwise, just point it toward the target and pull the trigger!
Sarge, they're dug in tight around this one.
Damn right! Now let’s finish this!
Miller! Get on that Machine Gun and give us some covering fire!
Miller, I'm talking to you.  Get over here!
So what's this new sarge like?
Word has it that he's a real ball breaker…
Attennnnshun!
Here are the new recruits,  Sargeant Sullivan.
Polonsky…
Sir Yes Sir!
Get over to that table and pick up a rifle, Miller…
The rest of you, move to that rifle range.  I want to see just how much much I've got to do here.
Smoke grenades next.  You'll use them to hide your movements on the battlefield and to confuse the enemy.  Take a few and throw one through the top floor window in that barn.
Don't think I'm letting you off with forgetting your rifle, Miller. One lap round the hill.  I'll be waiting at the finish line.
Ok, the smokes down, Go Go Go!
Hey, Sarge - I got a tunnel here.
Anderson, Burn it out. Everyone, stay back.
What are you waiting for, Miller? Get in there!
Oh you really are the best of the best aren't you Miller?  GET IN THERE!
C'mon, buddy.  We're holding 'em!
Polonsky!  Get some smoke up there. Anderson, Miller when the smoke hits, get in cover near the top!
You think we've got all day, Miller?  Pick up your Thompson.
Miller, there's a Thompson on that table. Get it now.
Okay, last  AA gun. Get a charge on it, Miller.
Trenches, ahead of us!  Watch for enemy activity!
Look up there!
Damn, that's one of our fly-boys...He's ditching it!
Until we take out those AA guns, we can forget about air-support, guys.
Not bad, Miller, not bad at all.  You might make it after all.
Let see how you are with grenades.  Go get some from the table there…
Ok.  Miller, shoot the helmets off the scarecrows.
Okay, good…
Okay, that's grenades. Follow me to the assault course
I want suppressing fire on that hill!
Get up, Miller.  You're not dead yet…
Anderson - I want some flame on that bunker.  Get up that hill and get on it.
Miller, you go with him.
We gotta keep moving, Marines! Get up there!
Arrrrrrrr!  Storm the hill
Nice work. Anderson -  go and check it out.
TRIPWIRE!
Argh!
Anderson!  Damn it!
Miller, get that flame thrower and take point.
Get in there, Marines! Go go!
Wow, excellent fruit-killing skills you've got there Miller!  Now stop messing around
The targets are over here, soldier!
Don’t get too excited, Marine.  Real targets move.....and fire back at you...
Not bad.. Not bad at all...
Polonsky, take care of that room.
Clearing room sir…
Take covering positions!
Miller, get out of the way of the flames!
Oh yeah baby, now they’re in trouble!
Let's go men! Move move move!
Miller, get over here and shoot these targets.
Miller, are you making the big mistake of intentionally trying to get on the wrong side of me?
MILLER! - Get over here,  that's an order!
The narrow end is where the bullet comes from Miller, now get shooting!
Sir, they've got us pinned down here.  We're gonna get cut to pieces, unless someone knocks out those MGs!
Keep your heads down!
Sir, Command says 161st has Shermans inbound on our location
Woo-hoo!  Looks like the cavalry's here!
Hey, Armor’s arrived!  Ooh-rah!
They're dug in tight around the AA gun.  We need to go through them to take out that AA!
Okay.  This must be Tenaro village… We need to press on through it and take out those  AA guns.
The Japanese have levelled the village.  Now they're using the ruins for cover.
They don't give up easy, do they?  Keep pushing them back, guys!
See that window on the ground floor?  Toss a frag grenade through it.
You're up first, Miller.  Pick up a Thompson from that table…
Alright, Marines, move on to the close quarters range… Follow me…
Let's have a recap of some basic combat maneuvers, demonstrated by Miller , of course…
Don't worry Miller, I'll be there every step of the way…
Get some fire in there!
ooh- Rah!  Nice and toasty eh boys?
Knock it off polonsky, Miller, get over there and clear it out. The rest of you stack up and wait for my signal
Stop flailing around.  Hey Fletch, I think this one's drowning - grab him!
Argh!  He's over there!
Nice shot!
This can’t be happening...
